cohort: 200 HIV-exposed infants in Ekiti State, South Western Nigeria
finding: Maternal ART use and infant feeding option significantly affected early infant diagnosis (EID) outcome, with a low overall HIV positivity rate (1.5%).
mod_finding: Baby's mode of delivery had an association with the final EID outcome (OR: 1.018, 95% CI: 0.998 - 1.038).
